prompts.prompt: For Symantec DLP's Indexed Document Matching document fingerprinting, roughly what percentage overlap with an indexed sensitive document is enough to trigger a partial-match detection? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/symantec-dlp/SKILL.md - IDM section: Detects partial matches, even 10-15% of a sensitive document triggers.

prompts.prompt: When training a Vector Machine Learning classification profile in Symantec DLP, what is the minimum recommended number of positive and negative example documents to upload before training? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/symantec-dlp/SKILL.md - VML process: Upload positive examples (50+ documents), Upload negative examples (50+ non-sensitive similar documents).

prompts.prompt: As a rough sizing guideline, how many endpoints can a single Symantec DLP Endpoint Server typically support? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/symantec-dlp/SKILL.md - Performance sizing: Endpoint Server, 1 server per ~5,000 endpoints (varies by incident volume).
